Sjællands Universitetshospital is a hospital located in [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], Denmark. It is systematically evaluated in the national Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) quality monitoring reports, which track clinical performance indicators for acute surgical patients across the Danish healthcare sector.

In the AKDB 2023 report, covering the period from September 1, 2022, to August 31, 2023, the hospital's performance for [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] (antibiotic treatment within three hours) was recorded at 33.5% [^src1]. Additionally, data from the same period showed that 9 out of 72 patients (12.5%) died within 30 days after acute surgery among those with a [[charlson-score-1-2|Charlson Score = 1 eller 2]] [^src3]. The hospital's demographic and clinical data, including age distributions and other mortality indicators, were also detailed in the 2023 report [^src2] [^src4].

In the subsequent AKDB 2024 report, covering September 1, 2023, to August 31, 2024, Sjællands Universitetshospital's result for Indikator 1 was 30.1% [^src5]. The 2024 publication further documented the hospital's metrics across various other quality indicators, including early nutritional assessment, 30-day and 90-day mortality rates, and stratified mortality based on comorbidity indices [^src6] [^src7] [^src8].
